## Outbound Reply Triage Router
Classifies replies to outbound sequences and routes them: **UNSUBSCRIBE · INTERESTED · OUT_OF_OFFICE · WRONG_PERSON · NOT_NOW · NOT_INTERESTED**, or **REVIEW** (human queue) when unsure.

**Deterministic rules first** (no LLM, no network) so opt-outs are honored predictably (CAN-SPAM / CASL). Optional LLM fallback only when `ENABLE_LLM_FALLBACK=true`.

**SAFE BY DEFAULT:** `SANDBOX_MODE=true` -> every action is only *logged* on the "Dry Run" node. Nothing is written to your CRM, no sequence is touched, nothing is posted to Slack.
Map the `YOUR_*_CREDENTIAL` placeholders on import. Use at your own risk - see DISCLAIMER.md.

### 1. Intake
POST a reply to the webhook (Header Auth required). The payload is validated and normalized (generic schema + tolerant Apollo / HubSpot aliases). Replies are de-duplicated by `replyId` (providers retry). Sandbox runs never record anything.

### 2. Classification
**Rules** score each label (noisy-OR of rule weights). An explicit opt-out always wins. Mixed signals ("sounds good, but not now") lower confidence.
**LLM fallback (optional):** only when confidence < `CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD`, never for an explicit opt-out. Text is redacted (emails/URLs/phones) and truncated; the answer is validated and confidence-capped. On any failure the rules result stands -> REVIEW.

### 3. Decide, enrich, plan
`confidence >= CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD` -> route = label. Otherwise **REVIEW** (Slack + CRM task). Opt-outs use the lower `UNSUBSCRIBE_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD` on purpose.
Optional read-only HubSpot lookup finds the contact + owner. **Plan Actions only builds a list** - it executes nothing. The webhook is answered here with the decision, so callers (and your curl tests) see the result immediately.

### 4. SANDBOX GATE
Sandbox ON (default) -> actions are logged to **Dry Run: Actions Logged** and stop.
Sandbox OFF -> each action is routed to its executor. Fail-safe: only `false / 0 / no / off` disable sandbox; typos keep it ON.

### 5. Executors and error handling
Every executor has an **error output** -> *Format Action Error* -> Slack alert (no reply content). Task creation is **not auto-retried** to avoid duplicate tasks. Create the second workflow "Reply Triage - Error Handler" and set it as this workflow's *Error Workflow* in Settings for failures outside the executors.

### Daily out-of-office resume
Out-of-office replies pause the sequence and queue a resume date (return date + `OOO_REENROLL_DELAY_DAYS`, or `OOO_DEFAULT_PAUSE_DAYS`). Each morning due items become a resume webhook call or a re-enroll reminder (CRM task / Slack). The queue lives in workflow static data (production runs only).

nodes.name: Reply Webhook
nodes.notes: Protect with a Header Auth credential (YOUR_WEBHOOK_AUTH_CREDENTIAL). Never expose this URL without it.

nodes.name: Load Config & Normalize
nodes.notes: Validates the payload, loads env config, de-duplicates by replyId.

nodes.name: Classify (Rules)
nodes.notes: Deterministic classification. No network.

nodes.name: LLM Classify
nodes.notes: OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint. Only reached when ENABLE_LLM_FALLBACK=true. Redacted text only.

nodes.name: Merge LLM Result
nodes.notes: Validates + caps the model answer; ignores anything malformed.

nodes.name: Decide Route
nodes.notes: Confidence gates -> route, or REVIEW.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Find Contact
nodes.notes: READ-ONLY. Finds the contact ID and owner by email.

nodes.name: Plan Actions
nodes.notes: Builds the action list. Executes nothing.

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook
nodes.notes: Returns the decision immediately (also in sandbox) - handy for curl tests.

nodes.name: Split Actions
nodes.notes: One item per action; records OOO resume entries in live mode only.

nodes.name: Dry Run: Actions Logged
nodes.notes: SANDBOX_MODE is on: inspect `action` on this node. Nothing was sent, written, or paused.

nodes.name: Route Action
nodes.notes: Outputs: 0 HubSpot opt-out · 1 suppression webhook · 2 Apollo stop · 3 sequence webhook · 4 HubSpot task · 5 Slack

nodes.name: HubSpot: Opt Out Contact
nodes.notes: WRITE: sets hs_email_optout=true (HubSpot treats this as irreversible via API).

nodes.name: Suppression Webhook
nodes.notes: WRITE: POSTs the opt-out to YOUR suppression system (URL from SUPPRESSION_WEBHOOK_URL).

nodes.name: Apollo: Stop Sequence
nodes.notes: WRITE: mode "stop" (default) halts steps and keeps context; "remove" is permanent. Verify against Apollo API docs.

nodes.name: Sequence Control Webhook
nodes.notes: WRITE: POSTs {action: pause|resume, ...} to YOUR sequence tool (URL from SEQUENCE_WEBHOOK_URL).

nodes.name: HubSpot: Create Task
nodes.notes: WRITE: creates a task. Not auto-retried (would create duplicates).

nodes.name: Post to Slack
nodes.notes: Posts to the incoming webhook in SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.

nodes.name: Format Action Error
nodes.notes: No reply content is included in error alerts.

nodes.name: Collect Due Resumes
nodes.notes: Reads the out-of-office queue (workflow static data).
